profile.headline: Software Engineer at State Farm ®
profile.summary:
I'm a former Air Force guy turned IT student looking to the future for jobs in IT.  I chose to major in Information Systems- Web Development because I enjoy programming and the challenges it provides. I've also seen the amazing creations from technology like arduino, 3d printing, websites and everything else and I couldn't help but to want to be a part of that.  I want to live in the technology sector that is both bringing the world together and into the future. 

I bring a fresh perspective because of the various places I've been, jobs I've had, the leadership and training I have received, as well as the ethics I maintain. I have an interest to learn about numerous ideas, industries, and especially technology.  Technology is where I truly have a drive because of the new and clever ways that people solve problems. At my core I'm a problem solver and that is what technology offers us new, better, and quicker ways to solve our problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and implemented new features in support of a Hadoop application for internal reporting and analytics
Troubleshot application errors to ensure customers receive their data in a timely manner
Maintained application in DevOps environment in which team members need to be cross-functional
Created new features using several technologies including Spring boot, java, bash, jenkins, git, junit, mockito, cucumber, etc
Worked in an agile manner and mindset to provide incremental and consistent releases/updates to application
Performed code reviews with team to show what code did, the pain points, and improve code quality.
Collaborated with team members through pair programming, planning sessions, and swarming on problems
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Site Reliability Engineering · Go (Programming Language) · Agile Methodologies · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloud Applications · Terraform

positions.title: Information Technology- Java Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed web application component for cloud tool in Java using the Spring Framework 
Wrote RESTful Services for CRUD operations in web application
Created mock/Junit tests for enterprise wide service using Mockito. 
Responsible for analysis and design of assigned projects as part of an Agile team

positions.title: Cell Leader
positions.description:
Supervised 20 people in the creation of electronic components for safety products in automobiles.   
Responsible for making the shift roster, troubleshooting machine malfunctions, training new personnel. 
Spearheaded new program training/supervisory program to improve efficiency
Adapted the workers creation plan in order to achieve company goals and ensure high quality.
Reported to managers on product plans, machine problems, work flow, personnel, and innovations
Scheduled routine preventive maintenance and the shift roster daily
Efficiently directed work flow to minimize downtime and increase production

positions.title: Area Supervisor
positions.description:
Oversaw 20+ personnel and ensured 100% compliance with established procedures
Supervised others in defense of America's priority resources eg. Nuclear weapons/Computers
Led joint task force of Italian/American forces for 4th of July security
Responsible for billion dollar Weapon system and supervised its security
Trained both new and experienced members 
Revised training process increasing quality rating average to 96%
Received multiple awards for excellence and creative solutions
Worked as part of a team filling sandbags for FEMA flood emergency in North Dakota
I ensured 100% documentation of all created performance reviews for those I supervised
Devised training plans for anyone in training for area supervisor on procedures and tactics

company.name: United States Air Force Security Forces

positions.title: Store Clerk
positions.description:
Assisted in advertising and establishing business goals/plans
Sold tanning packages to customers and repaired scratched disks
Rented, sold, and recommended  movies and other products/packages
Maintained cash  register and responsible for its accuracy and daily drop off
Key holder for business regularly opened and closed independently
Conducted routine cleaning of the store and tanning beds
